final_trustworthiness_assessment: HIGH. The dominant sources are official California state government agencies: CDPH (cdph.ca.gov) and the California WNV surveillance portal (westnile.ca.gov), both operated by CDPH/CDFA. The CDPH VBDS Annual Report 2024 is the gold-standard annual surveillance document. The CDC ArboNET historic data page provides federal-level cross-validation. County-level sources (kernpublichealth.com, ruhealth.org, nevadacountyca.gov, glamosquito.org) are official or quasi-official local public health entities. The contracosta.news article is a secondary source but explicitly republishes CDPH figures. The s47353.pcdn.co PDF is a 2023 document and should be deprioritized. Facebook results should be excluded. No peer-reviewed literature was surfaced, which is expected for a one-month 2024 window.
